name: report_revision
description: Report whether the learner can answer the task as it is written, rewriting it when it needed a change.

verdict.description: stands when the learner can answer it as written; rewritten when it needed a change; unfixable when even the answer does not give you enough to rebuild the task

task.description: The rewritten task, only when the verdict is rewritten. Change no more than what keeps the learner from answering.
